notes.title: We Are Releasing Real Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that our new title The Weird Dream will be arriving on PC Steam real soon! [i][b]Right now the build is being reviewed by Steam. We'll hit the RELEASE button once it is approved![/b][/i]

Inspired by Castlevania, Metroid, Dead Cells, and Hollow Knight, among other great games, The Weird Dream provides a brand new experience in a carefully handcrafted fantasy world. You play as a chainsaw-wielding bunny that mysteriously came to be to traverse dangerous but beautifully crafted environments and fight over 40 bosses to uncover the hidden secrets of this abnormally-altered world.

[previewyoutube=qRlIdObur88;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About The Weird Dream[/h2]
The Weird Dream is a 2D Metroidvania game set in the ruins of Alpha City. Control a mysterious bunny while confronting Alpha City’s mutated inhabitants. Level up your skills, and unravel the truth behind the City’s untimely destruction. The city holds many legends about the origin of a being only known as the Astral Lord, yet they all share a common detail: the Astral Lord answers sincere prayers and fulfills every desire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44535806/9a93abeebdfa33496e35fd0553add6912c7dabde.png[/img]

[h3]Background[/h3]
One day, you wake up and realize you're no longer your old self. Long ears, fluffy fur, and a bunny tail... Not only that, the once-familiar Alpha City is now almost unrecognizable and overrun by monsters. To discover the cause of your mutation and the city's ruination, you must embark on an epic adventure.


[h3]Features[/h3]
[b]Impeccably Tight Controls[/b] - Use a combination of in-game abilities, rhythm, and your own reflexes to traverse a skill-demanding world with controls that are easy to learn and less easy to master!

[b]Flexible Character Building[/b] - Unlock and experiment with new abilities to forge your unique combat style via an adaptable rune system

[b]Fragmented narratives[/b] - Uncover the dark secrets of this world by collecting monster profiles and story fragments

[b]Exciting Boss Fights[/b] - Challenge over 40 bosses. Utilize your powerful abilities to overcome formidable foes and earn more-than-generous rewards

[b]Diverse Exploration Areas[/b] - Embark on open-world exploration across seven distinct biomes and over 300 intricately detailed areas

[b]Mythical Setting[/b] - Explore the mysteries of The Weird Dream’s world with over 30 hand-drawn comics spanning 80 pages

[b]Languages [/b]- English and Simplified Chinese will be available at launch; other languages incl. Japanese will be available in an upcoming update.

Enjoy!
